answer_1.quote: Lexical Substitution is the task of generating appropriate words which can replace a target word in a given sentence without changing the sentence's meaning.
answer_1.outputs: substitute words for target words in sentences

answer_2.quote: We use the official metrics that the organizers provided in the original lexical substitution task of SemEval-2007 . These were best and best-mode which validate the quality of the model's best prediction and both oot (out-of-ten) and oot-mode to evaluate the coverage of the gold substitute candidate list by the 10-top predictions. We also use Precision@1
